phase_e1.name: Phase E1: Table 3 Stress Tests
phase_e1.description: LyASC under catastrophic residual scaling (skip_scale/residual_scale variations)

decisions.rationale: LyASC estimator hyperparameters for this run, from config YAML.

Completed 3-seed evaluation per pre-registered tolerance protocol. Strategy test errors:
           - LyASC+LN_none (3 seeds): 7.170% ± 0.212% (Seed 0: 7.33%, Seed 1: 7.25%, Seed 2: 6.93%)
           - LyASC+LN_damped (3 seeds): 7.460% ± 0.305% (Seed 0: 7.80%, Seed 1: 7.21%, Seed 2: 7.37%)
           - LyASC+LN_warmup (2 seeds): 7.950% ± 0.212% (Seed 0: 8.10%, Seed 1: 7.80%)
           1. warmup is confidently ruled out (+0.780pp gap vs none, no seed overlap).
           2. none and damped are statistically indistinguishable at n=3 (0.290pp gap vs 0.305pp within-group std for damped, remaining within the <=0.40pp tolerance band).
           3. none is selected as the Phase E–G baseline on pragmatic grounds: it has no extra cold-start hyperparameter to tune or justify, and the data provides no evidence that damped's added complexity yields any performance benefit.

Pre-scales shortcut path (skip_scale=0.5 for contracted skip) or residual branch (residual_scale=2.0, 3.0 for expanded residual) before applying the dynamic gate alpha_l(lambda_l). Preserves base_model Table 3 power ratios while enabling adaptive LyASC gating.

decisions.value: G() = LayerNorm2d for all Table 3 stress variants (stress_0.5, stress_2.0, stress_3.0)
decisions.rationale: Matches the exact normalization configuration where base_model experienced catastrophic failure (LN(0.5x+F)=37.14%, LN(x+2F)=37.59% bimodal, LN(x+3F)=49.27%), ensuring an apples-to-apples evaluation of whether LyASC gating rescues these unstable cases.

Noted unit error in draft Phase E plan executive summary (~3.8h stated vs 12.16h actual for 64k iters at 0.6842 s/iter). The 64,000-iter run time equals 64000 * (s/iter) / 3600. Corrected audit trail and updated budget estimates with steady-state benchmark measurements.
